source_of_truth: THIS file. The one consistent patch register. Sole writer: operations/scripts/jarvis-patch.py. logs/patch-log.json is a derived cache.

lifecycle.rule: A patch is any unit of change worth tracing. It gets a monotonic ID in chronological order the moment it is OPENED. While OPEN it keeps BUILDING — every change appends a dated entry — until it is EXECUTED.

states.partial: executed but carrying `remaining` items (still open for those)
states.deprecated: rejected/obsoleted by a later decision; not executed, not revivable as-specified
